text:
incident-bot: Pager: api-gateway-edge — elevated 502/504 spike detected. error_rate=3.8% (5m), p50 latency up 2x. Paging @ops-oncall and @ben-platform. Runbook: ingress-502s. Severity: SEV2.

sara: ack, I'm online. looking at dashboards — spike starts ~4412345600. lots of fanout to downstream auth-service.

mike: I see the same. top errors are 502 from edge -> upstream connection reset. hit rate concentrated to a handful of POPs (iad, fra).

jordan: running light curl checks against /v1/health: ```bash
for region in iad fra; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.${region}.redwood.example/v1/health; done
```
jordan: results: iad 502 0.24, fra 200 0.03 — suggests regional propagation.

sara: can we flip traffic away from iad POPs? Any active routing changes?

ben-platform: No intentional changes. Automatic muxing layer shows increased retransmits. Could be an upstream instance pool saturation. I'm enabling additional ingress workers in iad now (scale +3).

ops-oncall: taking ownership — moving to a private call. @cs-lead pls post CS guidance.

cs-lead: We're seeing customer reports from a small set of tenants reporting 502s and long tail timeouts. ETA for public status update in 30m unless we mitigate sooner.

mike: quick mitigation idea: enable route-level circuit breaker to reject to 429 for overloaded upstreams and send to fallback (fra). This avoids head-of-line collapse. Is that safe?

ben-platform: we have a fast-path to toggle mux policies. Applying per-POP traffic reweight: iad -> 10%, fra -> 90%. Pushing now.

incident-bot: Action logged: routing_reweight by ben-platform at 4412345648.

jordan: after reweight, sanity curl: iad 502 0.20 (small), fra 200 0.03. Error rate dropped to 1.2% in 2m. p95 latency down.

mike: also seeing connection_reset logs from proxy to auth-service. attaching snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T21:12:10Z] proxy[iad]: upstream write failed: ECONNRESET (fd=72)
[2026-03-15T21:12:11Z] proxy[iad]: queue depth 128/128, accept throttle triggered
```

ben-platform: queue depth indicates burst exhaustion. After reweight we still need to investigate root cause (upstream health probes, token bucket sizes). Creating follow-up ticket.

ops-oncall: Good mitigation. I'm leaving iad reweight in place and will keep autoscale up for +10m. If error_rate < 0.5% for 10m, we start gradual rollback.

cs-lead: Draft status update: "We are investigating an elevated rate of 502 errors affecting some API traffic. We have reweighted regional routing to reduce impact and error rates are improving. We will provide another update in 30 minutes." Approving? :thumbsup:

sara: approved. post to status page and ping support@customers.

incident-bot: Status update posted to status.redwood.example at 4412345675.

mike: note for postmortem: check recent config push 4412345400 — there was a small NGINX upstream timeout tweak. Might be correlated.

ben-platform: filing postmortem task: PMT-4821. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-infra.

jordan: error rate trending down to baseline 0.4% after 6m. p50 latency normalized.

ops-oncall: closing public incident phase. Keeping follow-up for root cause and prevention. Leaving channel in 10m unless someone else needs it.

cs-lead: Notifying impacted customers via templates. Good job team.

incident-bot: Incident: mitigation in place, monitoring. Final note: last_message 4412345695.
